acceptance_criteria.AC-DM01-1: A rollup over synthetic children with full data reports exact attempt-scoped totals for tokens, cost, calls, wall, agent-busy, parallelism, peak, budget-ledger retries, recovery dispositions, blockers, logical_nodes and feature_run_tries, and per-FeatureRun derived stats divided by logical_nodes with mean, median, and max.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM01-2: Any child with unavailable cost, missing busy, or zero usage records degrades the corresponding aggregate to the documented tri-state, never zero, with a reason string; a mixed peak population yields the partial lower-bound state.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM01-3: Live graphs expose started_at for client-side elapsed; terminal graphs report summary.json wall clock.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM01-4: For a node whose try history spans two graph attempts, the attempt-2 rollup excludes attempt-1 usage from totals and reports it only under lineage_totals.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM01-5: The cumulative merge is served through graph_metrics public functions with dashboard_server delegating; the merged document carries the labelled cumulative quality block alongside latest-try quality and per-try rows, covered by API tests.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM02-1: Catalog plan-graph records carry deterministic display_names that are unique within a merged catalog even when descriptors lack lineage IDs; feature-run records carry display_name and objective; node projections carry objective.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM02-2: Schema additions are optional properties; the existing committed fixtures validate unchanged; records lacking source prose fall back deterministically from objective to node_id to run_id.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM03-1: A snapshot for a terminal fixture graph validates against the new schema and matches the live rollup's numbers for the same fixture, both computed by the shared graph_metrics functions.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM03-2: The CLI is idempotent, writes atomically, refuses non-terminal graphs by default, never writes inside run directories, and --dry-run reports reconstructed, skipped, and failed counts without writing.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM03-3: Terminal runs through the runner script and recovery finalizations through plan_graph_recover.py both yield snapshots; a snapshot or registration failure leaves run status and journals untouched and is reported as a warning.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM03-4: The outcome block reports per-node objective, status, criteria ids satisfied/total, and non-success evidence reasons; graph-level attempted, succeeded, blocked, and failed counts; a delta block with base and final commits and change stats or unavailable with reason; criteria text only when the recorded decomposition digest matches, else the criteria_text_unavailable flag; and a narrative containing no value not present elsewhere in the document.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM03-5: A graph launched via the runner registers its run root in the default user-level registry at graph start, atomically, deduplicated, and pruned; registration failure is a warning only.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM04-1: /api/plan-graph-metrics/<id> serves the DM-01 rollup for live and terminal graphs; revision-derived aggregates recompute only when the catalog revision changes; no stale time-derived value is served.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM04-2: /api/snapshots lists snapshots discovered under audit roots with headline metrics and snapshot_missing stubs; a snapshot written after the server started is listed within one refresh interval; oversize, symlinked, or malformed snapshot files yield diagnostics, not failures of healthy listings or handler exceptions.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM04-3: With no --audit-root and no --audit-root-registry, run_dashboard.py loads the default user-level registry, and a graph launched in a fresh worktree appears in the catalog within one polling interval.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM05-1: With multiple live graphs in the catalog the In-flight strip lists all of them and switches selection without a reload; new in-flight graphs appear within one polling interval.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM05-2: The totals panel renders every DM-01 headline metric with explicit unavailable, estimated, or partial states including the lower-bound peak rendering and cumulative labelling, and updates while the graph runs.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM05-3: npm --prefix dashboard/plan-graph run verify and tests/test_dashboard_e2e.py pass; the committed dist build reflects the source changes and each built asset stays under the 1 MiB response ceiling.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM06-1: The completed viewer lists every snapshot and snapshot_missing stub the API serves and renders a selected snapshot's graph totals, per-node metrics, and outcome summary from the snapshot document alone, via the same components as the live view.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM06-2: The comparison table groups by logical graph by default with expandable attempt rows and a per-attempt toggle, sorts ascending or descending by every metric column with degraded values last, defaults to finished_at descending, and shows the metrics-complete filter with its hidden-row count.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM06-3: npm --prefix dashboard/plan-graph run verify and tests/test_dashboard_e2e.py pass; the committed dist build reflects the source changes and each built asset stays under the 1 MiB response ceiling.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM07-1: Backfill over a fixture corpus reproducing each historical degradation yields schema-valid snapshots with correct data_quality flags including the completeness grade, derived wall times, tokens unavailable rather than zero for zero-record runs, and skips launcher-style dirs with a diagnostic instead of failing the corpus.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM07-2: The runbook documents the exact post-merge operator commands including the --dry-run count verification to reconstruct all prior completed PlanGraphs and view them, states that the reconstruction requirement completes at that step, and logging-and-metrics.md and INDEX.md are updated.

runs.objective: Implement the PlanGraph-level metrics rollup module, move cumulative node-metric merging into it as the single shared implementation, and add cumulative quality counters across node tries.
Project human-readable display names, objectives, and the block-escalation indicator into run catalog records and extend the catalog snapshot schema with optional properties.
Define the plangraph metrics snapshot contract and implement the read-only builder, offline CLI, best-effort completion and recovery emission, and run-root self-registration.
Expose graph rollup and snapshot endpoints on the dashboard server with named bounds and per-request snapshot discovery, and enable default audit-root registry discovery in the dashboard runner.
Add the live PlanGraph totals panel and shared metric components, in-flight graph strip, human-readable names, and cumulative retry labelling to the dashboard UI.
